task: research-only classification of observed HbA1c >= 5.7% (not future type 2 risk)
threshold_rule: Provisional exploratory rule after seeing Validation: highest threshold in tested grid (0.100–0.600 step 0.025) with Validation recall >= 0.80; 80% is not a clinical target; do not retune based on Test.
test_use_policy: Single evaluation at locked threshold; if unsatisfactory, document limitation and do not tune/test repeatedly.
note: This file is a study protocol, not a trained model or observed test result.
